equipment_type: Water-cooled screw chiller / water-to-water heat pump (via SC-EQ card)
applies_to: YORK YVWH and YGWH water-to-water screw heat pumps and YVWE water-cooled screw chillers fitted with the SC-EQ communication card.
summary: YORK by Johnson Controls YVWH, YVWE and YGWH water-cooled screw units share one SC-EQ list on BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU / N2). A Read/Write block holds start/stop, run mode (cool, ice storage, heat pump, remote), leaving water setpoints per mode and over-current percentages per mode. Read points cover water temperatures, pressures, per-system motor and VSD values, and bit-coded digital I/O and fault words.
notes: Access comes from the sheet's Read/Write and Read sections.
Several AVs are bit-coded words (digital inputs/outputs and faults); the states list the bits. The sheet only gives bit tables written for system 1, so AV 57-59 have none.

All MV enums are printed in the points table (the sheet has no add-1 note). Multistate states with their own enum in the points table are shown as printed, from 0. BACnet multistate values start at 1, so the device may report the printed number + 1; confirm by discovery (read the state text).
Units shown are the IP units; with MV 65001 set to SI on the SC-EQ the card reports °C, kPa and so on.
System 2 points apply to dual-compressor units.

source.title: YVWH YVWE YGWH SC-EQ BAS Points List

integration.summary: Select the run mode with MV 1, start/stop with BV 1, and write the setpoint for the active mode (AV 1 cooling, AV 3 heat pump). MV 2 shows whether the unit is under local, remote or communication control. Read leaving water temperatures, % FLA and VSD run status, and alarm on BV 2.

integration.enable: MV 2 reports the control mode (local, remote, communication). The sheet does not say how to select it and gives no write-enable point.
setup: The BAS connects to the SC-EQ J12 port (RS-485: +, -, COM/REF, SHLD). The card detects BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU or N2 and the baud rate by itself; allow up to 120 seconds after power-up.
The MAC address (1-127) is set on DIP switch SW1 (switch 8 unused). Cycle the card's power after changing it.

The device instance defaults to 5000 + the MAC address (MAC 6 gives 5006). To use another number, set Device Instance Mode to Manual and enter the instance with the SC-AP / MAP tool, or write BV 65000 (mode) and AV 65000 (instance ID).
MV 65001 Units sets whether the BAS sees IP or SI values, independent of the chiller display; set it to match the chiller.
gotchas: The remote (commandable) setpoints read as unreliable until the BAS writes them the first time.
The SC-EQ only exposes the points that apply to the chiller it detects; if it replaces an E-Link, re-discover the device so old non-applicable points don't sit offline.
Leaving water setpoints are per mode (AC, ICS, HP, HTHP) and over-current percentages per mode (AC, ICS, HP); write the ones for the mode selected in MV 1.
